data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Weathered Expanse Clashes Intensify as Fisherman's Row Front Stabilizes
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Violent contested maneuvers in Weathered Expanse have produced fresh line shifts within the past two hours, leaving the sector split evenly at four bases apiece with one neutral ruin amidst combined casualty rates topping twelve hundred. In contrast, combat across Fisherman's Row has cooled following earlier turmoil, consolidating all nine strategic bases under Colonial control. Action has similarly moderated along the Stlican Shelf, where Warden forces have secured eight of nine positions amidst slowing local attrition. Inland meatgrinders nonetheless press forward with renewed intensity: Mooring County and Callahan's Passage recorded steep casualty surges over the last two hours alongside heavy troop arrivals, though neither front recorded immediate line changes. Stonecradle remains intensely contested under a narrow five-to-four Warden margin, while Farranac Coast exhibits accelerating casualties across its divided shoreline. Meanwhile, earlier coastal and island flare-ups in Godcrofts and Dead Lands have subsided into quiet holding operations.
